node.statement: Fix an epsilon_X-C*-algebra A as in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra and assume 0 <= epsilon_X <= 1/2. Put I=I_X, a=||I||, and J=I/a. The approximate-unit axiom gives |a-1|<=epsilon_X, hence a>=1/2, so J is defined; moreover ||J||=1, J^dagger=J because I^dagger=I, and ||J-I||=|1-a|<=epsilon_X.
